about_the_game:
About The Inspireist

Unravel the mysteries of the ocean spirit world by accompanying a recent high school graduate, Bulut, who lost all of his memories of family and friends. The Inspireist is a story-rich puzzle adventure narrative set in a recent 21st century, alternate realm Izmrr.

Gameplay

A chill indie mystery game with 2D hand-drawn animated characters in beautifully rendered 3D environments with lots of original comics, lore, and conversations.

Navigate through, help him remember and inspire Bulut, his family, friends and people of Izmrr

Solve puzzles, unravel the mysteries of Izmrr, the ocean spirit world, and to find more clues to reunite with your other half!

Development Status

The Inspireist is currently under development and does not currently have a release date or system requirements. Please add our game to your wishlist and follow our development on our Bluesky or twitter!
